steps.message: Open the dialer app. Clear any pop-ups that may appear by granting all permissions that are required.
Execute: adb shell pm list packages | grep -i dial

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell pm list packages | grep -i dial"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.DIAL

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.DIAL"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell pm list permissions | grep android.permission.READ_CONTACTS

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell pm list permissions | grep android.permission.READ_CONTACTS"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell pm grant com.android.dialer android.permission.READ_CONTACTS

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell pm grant com.android.dialer android.permission.READ_CONTACTS"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell pm grant com.android.dialer android.permission.CALL_PHONE

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell pm grant com.android.dialer android.permission.CALL_PHONE"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -i dialer | head -3

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -i dialer | head -3"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell pm grant com.google.android.dialer android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell pm grant com.google.android.dialer android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell pm grant com.google.android.dialer android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell pm grant com.google.android.dialer android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell pm grant com.google.android.dialer android.permission.PROCESS_OUTGOING_CALLS

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell pm grant com.google.android.dialer android.permission.PROCESS_OUTGOING_CALLS"
